name: Poly Property Group Co., Limited
summary: Poly Property Group Co., Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property investment, development, and management business in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and internationally. The company operates through Property Development, Property Investment and Management, Hotel Operations, and Other Operations segments. It involved in the development of residential and commercial properties; investment and management of properties; and investment, management, and operation of hotels, as well as restaurant business and provision of related services.
